chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from one of our companions, from Ismail ibn Riyah, from Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him), who said:
I asked him about the performer of the exclusive Umrah, is there Tawaf Al-Nisa upon him? He said: Yes.

key_terms.مُفْرِدِ: Mufrid (one performing Umrah only, distinct from Qarin or Mutamatti')

ai.seo_question: Is Tawaf Al-Nisa required for someone performing only Umrah?
ai.summary: In this concise narration from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) confirms the obligation of Tawaf al-Nisa (the farewell circumambulation) for a pilgrim performing Umrah al-Mufrada. This ruling highlights the distinct jurisprudential status of Umrah compared to Hajj, where the farewell Tawaf serves as the concluding act of worship, a point of emphasis in Shia fiqh regarding the completeness of the pilgrimage rites.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from one of our companions, from Ismail Bin Riyah, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘
I asked himasws about the performer of the exclusive Umra, ‘Is there Tawaaf Al-Nisa upon him?’ Heasws said: ‘Yes’.
en.sarwar: 8. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from certain persons of our people from ‘Isma‘il ibn Rabah who has said the following: “I once asked abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about a man who performs just al-‘Umrah; if he is required to perform Tawaf al-Nisa’.
He (the Imam) said, ‘Yes, he is required to do so.’”
